# Modulation Recognition

Identify the modulation format of a received wireless signal from I/Q samples, spectra, or derived signal representations.

**Aliases:** automatic modulation classification, AMC

**Datasets in catalogue:** 4

| Dataset | Inputs | Targets | Origin | Temporal structure | Samples | Access |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [HisarMod2019.1](../datasets/hisarmod2019-1.md) | I/Q samples | Modulation label | Synthetic | Sequence | 780,000 | Registration required |
| [RadioML 2016.10A](../datasets/radioml-2016-10a.md) | I/Q samples | Modulation label | Synthetic | Sequence | 220,000 | Registration required |
| [RadioML 2018.01A](../datasets/radioml-2018-01a.md) | I/Q samples | Modulation label | Synthetic | Sequence | 2,000,000 | Registration required |
| [spectrumHive IoT I/Q Dataset](../datasets/spectrumhive-iot-iq.md) | I/Q samples | Modulation label | Synthetic | Sequence | 120,000 | Open |
